# Snake — Arcade

## Project context

- Vite app built with React and TypeScript.
- Run locally with `npm install` followed by `npm run dev`.
- Create a production build with `npm run build`.
- Game controls: arrow keys or W/A/S/D; P pauses/resumes; Space starts/restarts. Mobile direction buttons are available.
- Keep the interface responsive and self-contained; do not add external assets or remote integrations.
